agentHost: render MCP embedded resources and resource links (#341586)

MCP tools can return `resource` and `resource_link` content blocks. The local harness shows them as
resource pills. The Copilot Agent Host dropped links, flattened text resources into plain text, and
sent blob resources without a URI, so they showed as "file.bin".

- Store embedded MCP resources and resource link metadata in a new session database table
  (`tool_result_resources`). Rows are deleted with their turn. Embedded content is capped at 8 MiB.
  Larger content and failed writes use the previous inline behavior.
- Send `Resource` references for these blocks. The URI path is only a display name and is not used
  for file system access. Clients read the content with `resourceRead`: embedded content comes from
  the session database, and links are read from the originating MCP server.
- Restore resource references from the session database when a session is replayed.
- Remove the flat SDK result text when it only repeats the structured text blocks.
- Move resource operations out of `AgentService` into an `IAgentHostResourceProviders` registry.
  Providers register for a URI scheme and implement only the operations they support.
  `FileSystemResources` implements all operations and is the fallback for other schemes.

To test: use the "everything" MCP server and call `get-resource-links`, `get-resource-reference`,
and `gzip-file-as-resource` in an Agent Host session. Resource pills show for each result and open
their content.

Fixes https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/340232
